overview: The Park is a 27-acre holiday park a short walk from the beach at Mawgan Porth, with lodges, cottages, yurts and cabins set among gardens. On-site facilities include indoor and outdoor heated pools, a sauna and steam room, a restaurant and café, a bar and children's play areas, and some properties take dogs.
